research_question: Does the chunked FP32 collector agree with exact authored stat_upd for the same CA/CD data on all four boundary channels?
hypotheses_with_opposing_predictions: Same promoted BF16 values, correct token dimension and absolute-before-average produce author agreement.
Wrong reduction axis or delta operation deviates on signed varying channels even if constants agree.
adversarial_counterexample: A constant or zero-delta statistic alone can hide reduction-order and axis defects.

checkpoint_numeric_recipe: No checkpoint, supplied BF16 values and FP32 reduction
full_depth_or_claim_scope: Small channel widths only; no real model.
predeclared_metrics: rtol/atol=2e-6 on non-negative magnitude and author normalized output
